# Engineering Standup

## Overview
This wiki page captures the notes and updates from the [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) engineering standup held on July 1, 2026. The session covered recent releases, infrastructure blockers, vendor updates, team wins, and upcoming tasks leading up to the demo.

## Key Details
- **[Mira's](./aurora-labs.md) Update:** Version 0.3.8 is officially released. Mira is actively monitoring GitHub issues for any rejoin regressions.
- **Jonah's Update:** The IP65 gasket vendor quote remains at $8,000, and the board has advised waiting.
- **Author's Update:** Successfully compiled the wiki featuring [heuristic mode](./heuristic-mode.md), bringing the total to over 40 pages.
- **Blockers:**
  - Alex's blog contains a battery typo (CR2450) that is still indexed somewhere.
  - The homelab forum scrape parser is currently broken on nested quotes.
- **Wins:**
  - Acquired 3 new [beta testing](./beta-testing.md) testers from thread #9102.
  - Alex sent a playful pebble-shaped stress ball joke gift named "[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md)".
- **Todo:** Run the extended dummy data generator prior to the upcoming demo.

## Related Entities
- **Aurora Labs:** The organization hosting the engineering standup.
- **Mira:** Engineering team member managing releases (v0.3.8) and monitoring GitHub issues.
